description: List of water ponds and earth dams built within the Badia Restoration Program until 2015 - CAP database, Jordan, 2016 - Data from: BRP. 2016. Cap projects, implementers and achievements. BRP Focal Point report is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Claudio Zucca, Pietro Bartolini. The dataset contains a list of 53 water harvesting interventions (water ponds and earth dams) implemented by the Badia Restoration Program (BRP) until 2015. The dataset includes also some notes form ICARDA-UNIFI, that tried to validate the data using satelite images during 2017. Coverage: national (JO); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
